model_annotation:
This figure consists of two subplots sharing the same y-axis label "BLEU," which represents translation performance measured in BLEU score. Both subplots use linear scales on their axes.

In the left subplot, the x-axis is labeled "α" with values ranging from 0.1 to 0.9, with tick marks at 0.1, 0.3, 0.5, 0.7, and 0.9 (intervals of 0.2). The y-axis is labeled "BLEU" and ranges from approximately 28.0 to 28.5, with tick marks at 28.0, 28.1, 28.2, 28.3, 28.4, and 28.5 (intervals of 0.1). A single blue line with circular markers and a solid line style is shown. The line starts at approximately 28.1 at α = 0.1, rises to around 28.3 at α = 0.3, reaches a peak of approximately 28.5 at α = 0.5, then decreases to about 28.4 at α = 0.7, and drops further to approximately 28.0 at α = 0.9. The peak occurs at α = 0.5 with a BLEU value of roughly 28.5.

In the right subplot, the x-axis is labeled "p" with values ranging from 0.05 to 0.45, with tick marks at 0.05, 0.15, 0.25, 0.35, and 0.45 (intervals of 0.1). The y-axis is labeled "BLEU" and ranges from approximately 28.0 to 28.5, with tick marks at 28.0, 28.1, 28.2, 28.3, 28.4, and 28.5 (intervals of 0.1). A single blue line with circular markers and a solid line style is shown. The line starts at approximately 28.1 at p = 0.05, rises sharply to a peak of approximately 28.5 at p = 0.15, then decreases to about 28.4 at p = 0.25, increases slightly to around 28.4 at p = 0.35, and drops to approximately 28.3 at p = 0.45. The peak occurs at p = 0.15 with a BLEU value of roughly 28.5.
